'''Ian Cook''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Naboo Regionals]] on 4 June 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HDADTJ duel]], according to Mike Kessling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d835">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-05-hatfield-uk-naboo-regional-part-2d835/ hatfield-uk-naboo-regional-part-2], DeckTech (Mike "Kessling" Kessling, 5 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-05-hatfield-uk-naboo-regional-part-2d835/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
